server_path_note: `images[].path` and `out_dir` are paths on the kernelCAD SERVER, not on your or the user's machine; you cannot open them. The images are attached to this result as image content, and `images[].url` is an HTTPS link to each PNG (expires at `images[].expires_at`) you can fetch or give to the user.
